title: feat(plugin-auth): export runOAuthConsentRequestRead and oauthConsentRequestDepsFor so a host that forwards the auth routes answers the consent page
body:
Fixes #32401

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — two functions and five types added to a package entry for a host's auth proxy; no metadata author writes anything new, and no published skill teaches the auth routes a host mounts

repo:cloud#4 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@objectstack/plugin-auth` 包入口新导出 `runOAuthConsentRequestRead`、`oauthConsentRequestDepsFor` 两个函数和五个类型(`OAuthConsentRequestManager`、`OAuthConsentRequestDeps`、`OAuthConsentRequestResult`、`OAuthConsentRequestData`、`ConsentRequestClient`)。只加导出,实现一行没改。
- 为什么改:托管环境(cloud)的认证代理无法挂载 `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth-consent/request`,授权页拿不到 200 就禁用「授权」,所有托管环境都连不上 Claude 等 MCP 客户端(cloud#4326,p0)。有了这两个导出,cloud 用环境的 AuthManager 加请求即可得到与框架路由完全相同的答复,不必在 cloud 重写。
- 风险与回滚:极低。不改行为,只扩大包的公开面;回滚即删掉 `index.ts` 中这一段导出。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/index.ts`(新增的导出段);`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-consent-request.real-plugin.test.ts`(末尾新增的入口钉子,按宿主的调用方式跑 200 与 401)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/oauth-consent-request.real-plugin.test.ts`,预期 12 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地;落地后 cloud 需提升 `.objectstack-sha` 并在认证代理挂上这条路由(cloud#4326 的另一半)。

## What changes

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/index.ts` re-exports, from `./oauth-consent-request.js`, the two functions AuthPlugin's own `POST /oauth-consent/request` mount already calls, and the types a host needs to call them:

- `runOAuthConsentRequestRead(deps, request)` and `oauthConsentRequestDepsFor(manager)`;
- `OAuthConsentRequestManager` (the slice of `AuthManager` the deps builder reads: `getApi`, `getAuthContext`, `getDataEngine`; `AuthManager` satisfies it structurally, which is how AuthPlugin already passes `this.authManager`), `OAuthConsentRequestDeps`, `OAuthConsentRequestResult`, `OAuthConsentRequestData`, `ConsentRequestClient`.

No helper private to `AuthPlugin` was needed: the deps builder takes the manager alone. Nothing in `oauth-consent-request.ts` changes, so every answer and refusal is the one AuthPlugin's mount gives today.

The import line a host uses, and the call (the same pattern as `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff` in cloud's `auth-proxy-plugin.ts`):

```ts
import { oauthConsentRequestDepsFor, runOAuthConsentRequestRead } from '@objectstack/plugin-auth';

const answer = await runOAuthConsentRequestRead(oauthConsentRequestDepsFor(authSvc), {
  raw: c.req.raw,
  queries: c.req.queries() ?? {},
});
return c.json(answer.body, answer.status, answer.headers);
```

Changeset: `.changeset/32401-oauth-consent-request-export.md`, `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (the level follows `Metadata-protocol: none`).

## Tests

A new top-level describe in the existing harness `oauth-consent-request.real-plugin.test.ts` imports from `./index` and:

- asserts both function names are keys of the package root;
- drives the read the way a forwarding host does, with no AuthPlugin route and no Hono app: a real `AuthManager`, a client registered through `/oauth2/register`, the signed query taken from the provider's own `/oauth2/authorize` redirect, then `runOAuthConsentRequestRead(oauthConsentRequestDepsFor(manager), { raw, queries: {} })`. It answers `200` with the signed `redirectUri`, `registeredByAdministrator: false` and `Cache-Control: no-store`, and the same request without a session answers `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`.

The test layer's tsc program compiles the file (`tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` counts it once), so a type export removed from the entry reds `check:test-typecheck` too.

## Acceptance notes

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED locally: it exits 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`) because packages outside this diff have no `dist/` in this worktree. In its place, plugin-auth's built CJS entry was loaded by hand: `require('./dist/index.js')` and `import('@objectstack/plugin-auth')` both answer `function function` for the two names. CI runs the gate on a full build.
- Same class as cloud#4326's recurrence note: plugin-auth's `objectstack-mount` routes reach a forwarding host only when the package exports their body. Not acted on here (outside this card's file surface).
